scientific_integrity: The all-k theorem is proved by an exact one-defect interval classification; finite brute-force checks are corroborative and not extrapolated to a proof. Known path/cycle burning numbers and previously known square-path nonredundancy are distinguished from the new enumerations.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple vertex-labelled paths and cycles only, at orders k squared and k squared minus one for integers k at least two. Counts are of time-ordered legally timed ignitions, not relaxed tuples. Independent mathematical audit and comprehensive historical-priority verification have not been performed.
title: One-defect rigidity and exact counts of optimal burning sequences on paths and cycles
